echogeist.desc: a translucent ghost the shape of a human traveler, pale blue-white ectoplasm body, a hooded traveling cloak, a pack strap and walking stick, blurred double outlines like an echo, empty glowing white eyes, the lower body fading into mist, a gaunt sad face, worn boots faintly visible above the mist, and thin wisps trailing from the cloak edges
echogeist.neg: solid flesh, legs on ground, skeleton

erzlich.desc: an ancient lich about the height of a man, skeletal body in long robes of deep purple and gold with arcane symbols, a tall pointed crown of black metal, a staff topped with a floating violet crystal, glowing violet eyes in a skull and floating runes around the hands

sternendrache.desc: a huge dragon about four times the height of a man, sleek body on four clawed legs, two large wings with dark membranes, deep navy-blue scales covered in tiny glowing white and gold points like stars, a horned head with glowing silver eyes and a long tail with a star-like glow at the tip

skelettkrieger.desc: a human skeleton warrior the height of a man, yellowed bones, a dented old iron helmet, pieces of rusty chainmail over the ribcage, a tattered cloth belt, holding a notched rusty sword in one hand and a cracked wooden shield in the other, dim red eye points
skelettkrieger.neg: flesh, skin, two heads, clean armor

seuchenlich.desc: a plague lich about the height of a man, skeletal body with rotting green-grey flesh, a tattered robe of dark crimson and black, a hood and bone crown, a staff topped with a skull leaking green mist, glowing sickly green eyes and green rot dripping from the fingers

knochendrache.desc: an undead dragon about four times the height of a man, only a skeleton of grey-white bones, four clawed legs, two large bony wings with torn black membrane rags, a horned skull with burning dark purple fire in the eye sockets and chest, a long bone tail
knochendrache.neg: flesh, scales, skin, two heads, rider

wurzelschleim.desc: a blob of green slime about knee-high, round semi-transparent jelly body in bright moss green, small roots, twigs and leaves trapped inside, a darker green core, a glossy wet surface and two small dark eye spots, a slightly flattened bottom, small bubbles inside the jelly, a short stubby root poking out of the top and dripping green goo at the edges

farnhirsch.desc: a slender red deer stag about the height of a man at the head, reddish-brown coat with pale spots along the back, white rump patch, large branching antlers with green fern fronds growing from the tines, dark eyes, slender legs with dark hooves, a pale throat, large ears and a few small fern leaves tangled in the neck fur
farnhirsch.neg: horse, saddle, standing on hind legs

borkenbaer.desc: a big brown bear about chest-high at the shoulder, heavy body with thick legs and large claws, dark brown fur on legs and belly, the back and shoulders covered with thick plates of rough grey-brown tree bark with moss, small dark eyes, a broad head with small round ears and a brown muzzle
borkenbaer.neg: standing on hind legs, saddle, armor

pilzling.desc: a walking mushroom creature about knee-high, a thick pale beige stem body with two short stubby legs and two small root-like arms, a large round cap in red-brown with white spots, small dark eyes under the cap rim, puffs of yellow spores, a wide gill ring under the cap and tiny root toes

netzweberin.desc: a giant forest spider about knee-high and as wide as a man is tall, round abdomen with dark brown and olive-green mottled pattern, eight long hairy jointed legs with light bands, a cluster of eight shiny black eyes and two short fangs, pale silk glands at the abdomen tip and fine bristles on the legs
netzweberin.neg: insect wings, six legs, two heads, web

bambuswicht.desc: a small goblin-like creature about knee-high, thin wiry body with smooth pale green skin with bamboo-like rings on the limbs, pointed ears, a big grin, a loincloth of woven leaves, a bamboo-leaf headband, and a small bamboo spear in one hand, bare feet, thin limbs and big yellow eyes

harzgolem.desc: a lumpy golem about one and a half times the height of a man, body of thick sticky amber-orange resin with dark petrified wood chunks and old roots embedded inside, glossy drips and strings, two heavy arms, short legs, a small lumpy head with two dark eye holes

kronenharpyie.desc: a huge harpy eagle about as tall as a man, powerful bird body, slate-grey back feathers with a white chest and black band, a large crest of feathers on the head like a crown, a strong black hooked beak, sharp eyes and thick yellow legs with long talons

nebeleule.desc: a giant owl about as tall as a man, round, soft-feathered body, pale grey and white plumage with faint misty patterns, a round facial disc, large dark eyes, a small hooked beak, short ear tufts and feathered legs with black talons, a short fan-shaped tail and broad folded wings

dryade.desc: a female tree spirit about the height of a woman, slender body made of smooth pale bark with wood grain, long hair of hanging green leaves and small flowers, glowing soft green eyes, a calm face, vines wrapping arms and legs, the lower body blending into roots

werwolf.desc: a werewolf about one and a half times the height of a man, muscular upright body, digitigrade wolf legs, long arms with clawed hands, thick dark grey-brown fur, a wolf head with long snout and fangs, glowing yellow eyes and torn remains of trousers, and a long bushy tail

uralter_treant.desc: an ancient walking tree about five times the height of a man, massive trunk of dark gnarled bark covered in moss and lichen, two huge branch arms, thick root legs, a wide crown of leaves, a deeply carved old face in the bark with glowing amber eyes and a long beard of hanging moss

feenkoenigin.desc: a slender fairy queen about the height of a human child, delicate pale lilac skin, long silver-white hair woven with tiny glowing mushroom caps, two pairs of large translucent moth-like wings with soft cyan glowing veins, a delicate crown of luminous blue mushrooms, a flowing gown of layered petals and moss, large dark eyes with faint blue glow, bare feet
feenkoenigin.neg: insect body, adult giant, armor, four arms, two heads

geroellnager.desc: a stocky marmot-sized rodent about knee-high when upright, compact barrel-shaped body, coarse gray-brown fur dusted with stone powder, oversized chisel-like orange incisors chipped at the tips, small round ears, short strong legs with digging claws, a short bushy tail, patches of hard slate-gray skin like pebbles on the back and shoulders
geroellnager.neg: rabbit, squirrel tail, long legs, two heads

klippenadler.desc: a gigantic eagle twice the height of a man, broad powerful body, dark chestnut-brown feathers with a pale cream-gold head and neck, massive hooked yellow beak, piercing amber eyes, huge thick yellow legs with long black talons, broad wings with ragged dark wingtip feathers, short fan-shaped barred tail
klippenadler.neg: human arms, four legs, two heads, saddle

hoehlenbaer.desc: a massive cave bear standing on all fours as tall as a man at the shoulder, enormous muscular hump, thick shaggy dark umber-brown fur with gray streaks around the muzzle, broad heavy skull with small dark eyes, long curved ivory claws, thick scarred hide on the face, short stubby tail
hoehlenbaer.neg: standing upright, saddle, clothing, panda colors

erzkaefer.desc: a large beetle about knee-high, heavy domed shell of dark iron metal with veins of glinting copper and gold ore running across it, six thick segmented legs with blunt metal-tipped feet, short powerful mandibles like rock crushers, small black eyes, two short club-shaped antennae, a riveted-looking armored underside
erzkaefer.neg: eight legs, wings spread, spider, smooth plastic

schneeleopard.desc: a lean snow leopard about the size of a large dog, smoky white-gray thick fur covered in dark gray rosettes and spots, very long thick fluffy tail as long as its body, broad padded paws, short rounded ears, pale green eyes, powerful hindquarters and slender athletic build
schneeleopard.neg: tiger stripes, orange fur, standing upright, short tail

bergkobold.desc: a small wiry kobold about waist-high to a human, gray-brown leathery skin, large pointed ears, long hooked nose, beady yellow eyes, crooked teeth, wears a dented miner's helmet with a candle stub, patched leather tunic and tool belt, holds a short pickaxe, oversized calloused hands and bare dirty feet

quarzelementar.desc: a humanoid elemental twice the height of a man, body built entirely of clustered translucent white and pale pink quartz crystals, faceted crystal shards jutting from shoulders and back, thick crystal-pillar legs and heavy arms ending in jagged crystal points instead of hands, a faceless head of a single prism with a faint inner white glow
quarzelementar.neg: flesh, skin, clothing, face with mouth, fire

windharpyie.desc: a harpy about human height, lean female upper body with ash-gray skin, wild windswept pale blue-gray hair, large feathered wings in place of arms with slate and white feathers, lower legs of a bird of prey with yellow scaly skin and black talons, short tail feathers, sharp yellow eyes, sharp nose
windharpyie.neg: human hands, four arms, clothing, halo

basilisk.desc: a long low-slung lizard about the length of two men, eight short powerful splayed legs in four pairs along its body, rough olive-green and dull yellow scales, a row of bony spikes along the spine, a heavy blunt head with a small crest, large glowing pale yellow eyes with slit pupils, long tapering tail
basilisk.neg: four legs, wings, chicken, rooster, standing upright

steinriese.desc: a hulking stone giant three times the height of a man, gray granite-like skin with cracks and patches of lichen, massively broad shoulders, long heavy arms with huge boulder-like fists, small deep-set eyes under a heavy brow, bald knobbed head, wears a crude loincloth of hide held by a rope belt

wyvern.desc: a small wyvern about the size of a horse, two strong hind legs and two large leathery wings acting as forelimbs, dusky olive-green scales with a pale yellow underbelly, narrow horned head with sharp teeth, long whip-like tail ending in a curved barbed venom stinger dripping green, membrane wings with darker green veins
wyvern.neg: four legs, arms, rider, saddle, two heads

zwergenkoenig_der_tiefe.desc: an undead dwarf king, stocky and broad, slightly shorter than a man, gray withered skin stretched over bone, hollow eye sockets with faint blue glow, long braided white beard with iron rings, tarnished golden crown, heavy dwarven plate armor rusted and covered in cave dust, a massive two-handed war hammer, tattered royal cape

donnervogel.desc: an enormous thunderbird three times the height of a man, deep indigo and storm-gray plumage with jagged white zigzag feather patterns like lightning, large hooked silver beak, glowing electric-blue eyes, huge wings with crackling pale blue tips, long crest of feathers on the head, strong black talons
donnervogel.neg: human arms, four legs, two heads, rider

heidehase.desc: a nimble hare slightly larger than a normal one, about shin-high, sandy brown fur speckled with gray and heather-purple tints, very long black-tipped ears, large dark eyes, long powerful hind legs, white fluffy underbelly and short white tail, a slim lean body
heidehase.neg: rabbit with short ears, standing upright, clothing

torfkroete.desc: a fat bloated toad about knee-high, wide flat body, warty dark brown skin with peat-black and mossy green blotches, bulging orange eyes, very wide mouth with dripping yellow-green slime, pale mottled belly, short thick legs with webbed toes, swollen poison glands behind the eyes

wacholderviper.desc: a thick-bodied viper about the length of a man, gray-brown scales with a dark zigzag pattern along the back and dusky blue-green flecks like juniper berries, a broad triangular head with heat pits, vertical slit pupils in copper eyes, short tapering tail
wacholderviper.neg: legs, arms, feet, lizard, two heads

hochlandwidder.desc: a powerful highland ram slightly larger than a pony, thick shaggy cream and rust-brown wool coat hanging long around the legs, massive spiraling horns curled around the sides of the head, broad battle-scarred face, amber eyes with horizontal pupils, sturdy legs with cloven hooves
hochlandwidder.neg: saddle, rider, standing upright, goat beard too long

sturmfalke.desc: a fast falcon about the size of a large eagle, sleek streamlined body, slate-blue back feathers and pale underside with dark barring, long pointed wings with white streaks like wind lines, black mustache stripe beneath dark eyes, short hooked yellow beak, yellow legs with black talons
sturmfalke.neg: four legs, human arms, two heads, owl face

moorkobold.desc: a sneaky bog kobold about waist-high to a human, mottled greenish-gray clammy skin, long droopy ears, wide froglike mouth with needle teeth, pale milky eyes, hunched posture, wears ragged moss-covered rags and a hood of reeds, a pouch of mud stones on its belt, long thin fingers, bare webbed feet

rauchfarn_schleicher.desc: a lean cat-like predator the size of a panther, body partly made of drifting gray smoke and dark green fern fronds, fern leaves forming its mane and tail tip, smoky translucent edges around the legs, glowing pale green eyes, long thin tail trailing wisps of smoke
rauchfarn_schleicher.neg: standing upright, solid fur only, two heads

windharfen_geist.desc: a floating wind spirit about human height, translucent pale silver-blue body like flowing mist with a vaguely female face and long streaming hair, no legs but a trailing swirl of air, harp-like strings of light stretching between its arms, small glowing white eyes, ribbons of vapor around it
windharfen_geist.neg: solid flesh, legs on ground, harp instrument held

banshee.desc: a wailing ghost woman about human height, gaunt translucent pale green-white body, long tangled white hair flowing upward, hollow dark eye sockets, wide open screaming mouth, tattered gray shroud dissolving into mist below the waist, long thin clawed fingers, faint ghostly glow
banshee.neg: solid flesh, legs on ground, pretty face

kopfloser_reiter.desc: a tall headless undead knight, no head on the shoulders and only a ragged collar with drifting dark smoke at the neck, dark rusted plate armor over a black tattered cloak, a carved pumpkin-like glowing lantern hanging from the belt, a long notched sword in one hand, heavy riding boots

zentaur.desc: a centaur about one and a half times the height of a man, upper body of a muscular human with tanned skin, long brown braided hair and stern face, lower body of a chestnut horse with four legs and hooves, leather chest strap with a quiver of arrows, a longbow in hand, long dark horse tail
zentaur.neg: saddle, two legs, rider on horse

heidedrache.desc: a slender heath dragon about the size of a large horse, four thin legs and two narrow leathery wings, earth-brown scales with ochre and faded heather-purple patterning, lean long neck and long tail, small swept-back horns, calm amber eyes, wing membranes in dusty brown

einhorn.desc: an elegant white unicorn the size of a horse, pure white coat, long flowing silver-white mane and tail, a single long spiral pearly horn on the forehead, gentle light blue eyes, slender legs with silver cloven hooves and feathered fetlocks, small goat-like beard
einhorn.neg: saddle, rider, wings, two horns, rainbow

strandlaeufer.desc: a long-legged shorebird about waist-high to a human, slender body with sandy-gray back feathers speckled white, white belly, very long thin black legs, long slightly curved dark beak, small round black eyes, short pointed tail, compact folded wings, a faint chestnut band across the chest and pale gray scaly toes
strandlaeufer.neg: four legs, human arms, two heads

schwarztang_egel.desc: a giant leech about as long as a human arm, soft segmented slimy body, glossy black-green skin with dark kelp-like stripes and fringes, a round sucker mouth ringed with tiny teeth at one end, a broader sucker at the tail, no legs, no visible eyes, wet glistening surface

kliffmoewe.desc: a giant seagull about chest-high to a human, bulky body, white head and belly, pale gray wings with black tips and white spots, thick yellow hooked beak with a red spot, pale yellow eyes, pink webbed feet, scruffy loud expression
kliffmoewe.neg: human arms, four legs, two heads

duenenschakal.desc: a lean jackal about the size of a medium dog, sandy golden-tan coat with a dark saddle-shaped patch of black and silver fur on the back, large upright pointed ears, long narrow muzzle, amber eyes, slender legs, bushy black-tipped tail

perlmuschel_schnapper.desc: a giant clam as wide as a man is tall, two heavy ridged shells colored mother-of-pearl white with pink and blue sheen, jagged tooth-like edges along the shell rims, a soft pale pink fleshy body visible inside with a large glowing pearl, barnacles and small seaweed on the outer shell

riffaal.desc: a long moray-like reef eel about the length of two men, muscular snake-like body with a continuous fin along the back, mottled yellow and teal skin with dark spots, wide gaping jaws with needle-like teeth, small cold eyes, no pectoral fins, tapering tail
riffaal.neg: legs, arms, snake scales, two heads

nebelsirene.desc: a slender siren woman about human height, pale gray-blue skin with faint scale patches on the shoulders and hips, long wet dark hair tangled with seaweed, finned ears, large silvery eyes, webbed hands with long nails, a ragged gown of gray sea mist fabric and kelp, webbed bare feet

sturmglas_elementar.desc: a whirling humanoid elemental about twice the height of a man, body formed of a spinning tornado of tan sand and sharp glinting glass shards, a dense core torso and rough head with two bright white glowing eye spots, arms of swirling sand and glass, tapering to a funnel instead of legs

blaufeuer_qualle.desc: a large floating jellyfish about as wide as a man, translucent bell-shaped dome glowing with bright blue flame-like light, frilly rim, many long trailing stinging tentacles with flickering blue fire tips, inner glowing organs visible through the clear body, the bell rim lined with small glowing blue spots and four short frilled oral arms hanging in the middle

meerjungfrau.desc: a mermaid about human length, upper body of a woman with sun-tanned skin, long wavy aquamarine hair, shell ornaments in the hair, a top of woven seashells, lower body a long fish tail with iridescent teal-green scales and a wide translucent tail fin, small fins at the wrists, sea-green eyes

geisterpirat.desc: an undead ghost pirate of human height, translucent pale green ghostly skin over a gaunt skull-like face, glowing green eyes, scraggly beard, tattered long captain's coat, torn striped shirt, tricorn hat, a curved cutlass sabre in hand, rotten wooden peg leg, wisps of mist around the edges

riesenkrake.desc: a gigantic octopus several times the size of a man, bulbous deep red-purple mantle with pale spots, eight very long thick tentacles with rows of white suckers, huge golden eyes with horizontal pupils, rough barnacle patches on the head, a hidden beak beneath
riesenkrake.neg: fish tail, legs, human features, ship

kuestentitan.desc: an ancient titan five times the height of a man, body of dark wet coastal rock covered in barnacles, mussel shells, starfish and hanging seaweed, massive shoulders like cliffs, long arms with stone fists, a craggy head with glowing sea-green eyes and a beard of kelp, tide-worn pillar legs

sumpfmuecke.desc: a giant mosquito about the size of a fist, thin segmented body with dark brown and pale green stripes, two narrow translucent iridescent wings, six very long thin legs, a long needle proboscis, large red compound eyes, feathery antennae, swollen semi-transparent abdomen
sumpfmuecke.neg: eight legs, four wings, fur, spider

schilfreiher.desc: a large heron about the height of a man, long S-shaped neck, blue-gray feathers with a reed-green sheen on the back, white face with black head plume, long sharp dagger-like yellow beak, very long thin yellow legs, long drooping chest feathers
schilfreiher.neg: four legs, human arms, two heads, flamingo pink

moorkrokodil.desc: a heavy bog crocodile about three times the length of a man, armored back of dark brown-green knobby scutes covered with moss and duckweed, broad flat snout with jagged protruding teeth, yellow eyes on top of the head, short splayed legs, long powerful tail with a ridged crest
moorkrokodil.neg: standing upright, two heads, smooth skin

faeuleblueten_ranke.desc: a carnivorous plant about the height of a man, a thick rotting purple-green stalk rising from a mass of roots, a huge drooping blossom with fleshy dark red petals spotted yellow and a toothed mouth at its center, several long thorny tendrils whipping out from the base, drooping leaves with brown rot spots

leuchtmoos_schnecke.desc: a giant snail as long as a man, soft grayish slimy foot, large spiral shell covered in thick moss that glows soft green and teal, tiny luminous mushrooms on the shell, two long eye stalks with glowing tips and two short feelers, a glistening slime trail edge

sumpftroll.desc: a hulking swamp troll twice the height of a man, slimy dull green skin covered in warts and patches of algae, long drooping arms reaching the knees, big flat feet, large crooked nose, small yellow eyes, wide mouth with tusks, stringy black hair with reeds, a loincloth of rotten hides

tintenaal.desc: a long black eel about the length of a man, smooth glossy ink-black skin with faint purple sheen, continuous dark fin along the back and belly, blunt head with small pale violet eyes, wisps of black ink leaking from small gill openings, tapering tail

silberreiher_geist.desc: a ghostly heron about the height of a man, translucent shimmering silver-white body with faint blue glow, long slender neck and long beak, wispy feathers dissolving into mist, long thin legs fading out near the bottom, softly glowing pale eyes, trailing ethereal plumes

echsenmensch.desc: a lizardfolk warrior about human height, scaly green skin with brown banding, a reptilian head with a short frill and yellow slit eyes, long tail, clawed hands and feet, wears a bone necklace and crude hide loincloth with a leather strap, holds a bone-tipped spear in one hand and a woven rope net in the other

hydra.desc: a monstrous hydra about four times the length of a man, heavy serpentine body on four short thick webbed legs, five long snake-like necks each ending in a separate fanged head, dark teal-green scales with a pale yellow belly, finned crests along each neck, yellow slit eyes, long finned tail

sumpfvampir.desc: a pale swamp vampire of human height, gaunt bluish-white skin, sunken red glowing eyes, long sharp fangs, long thin clawed fingers, stringy black wet hair, a tattered dark noble coat stained with mud and moss, torn high collar, ragged trousers, bare bony feet

ghul.desc: a gaunt ghoul about human height, hunched with long limbs, gray-green rotting skin tight over bones, sunken milky eyes, wide mouth of jagged yellow teeth, long black claws on hands and feet, scraps of torn burial cloth around the waist, patchy thin hair

schwarzwasser_drache.desc: a large black swamp dragon about the size of an elephant, four legs and two big leathery wings, glossy black scales with dark green sheen and bubbling acid-green patches, broad head with backward curving horns, glowing green eyes, acid dripping from the jaws, webbed claws, long tail with fin crest

wuestenspringmaus.desc: a tiny jerboa about the size of a hand, round sandy-beige body with white belly, huge round ears, big dark eyes, tiny forelegs, very long hind legs for hopping, extremely long thin tail ending in a black-and-white tuft, soft whiskers, a pale pink nose and fine sandy fur with a faint darker stripe across the hips

kupferskarabaeus.desc: a scarab beetle about knee-high, rounded shell of polished copper with green patina spots, six spiky legs, broad toothed head shield, short clubbed antennae, small black eyes, engraved-looking ridges on the wing cases, a metallic bronze-orange sheen on the legs, serrated front legs for digging and a faint turquoise patina along the shell seams

oasenloewe.desc: a strong lion the size of a real lion, golden sand-colored coat, a thick dark brown mane streaked with teal-green tints, muscular build, amber eyes, a long tail with a dark tuft, faint pale blue water-like markings on the forelegs

sandviper.desc: a sand viper about the length of an arm and a half, thick body with sand-yellow scales and pale brown diamond pattern, small horn-like scales above each eye, a broad triangular head, black slit pupils in golden eyes, short tapering tail
sandviper.neg: legs, arms, feet, lizard, two heads

geierschwarm.desc: a large vulture about chest-high to a human, bald wrinkled red-pink head and neck with a ruff of pale feathers at the base, dark brown-black plumage, hooked ivory beak, dark eyes, broad ragged wings, gray scaly legs with blunt talons
geierschwarm.neg: four legs, human arms, two heads, flock

sandorgel_fledermaus.desc: a large bat with a wingspan as wide as a man is tall, sandy-tan fur, leathery pale brown wings with organ-pipe-like ridges along the bones, oversized ribbed ears like tubes, small black eyes, pug nose, tiny fangs, clawed thumbs, a pale cream chest, darker brown wing edges and small hooked claws on the feet
sandorgel_fledermaus.neg: bird feathers, human body, four arms

kaktuslaeufer.desc: a walking cactus about the height of a man, a column-shaped green cactus body with vertical ribs covered in long yellow spines, two thick branch-like arms, two stumpy root legs, a pink cactus flower on top, two dark hollows as eyes, small dried brown patches

sandelementar.desc: a whirling humanoid made of golden sand about one and a half times the height of a man, a dense sand torso and head with two hollow dark eye pits, arms of flowing sand ending in clumped fists, lower body twisting into a swirling sand vortex, small pebbles orbiting the body

wuestenraeuber_skelett.desc: an undead skeleton of a desert bandit, human height, sun-bleached bones, a faded tattered desert headscarf and face veil hanging from the skull, ragged sand-colored robes, a leather belt with empty pouches, a curved rusted scimitar in one hand, glowing orange pinpoint eyes

dschinn.desc: a djinn spirit with a muscular blue-skinned upper body about human size, bald head with a long black topknot, pointed ears, golden eyes, golden arm bands and earrings, a lower body dissolving into a swirling smoky tail of wind instead of legs, cracks of golden light on the skin

sphinx.desc: a large sphinx the size of an elephant, body of a golden-tan lion with four legs and long tufted tail, two great feathered eagle wings folded on its back, an ageless human face with dark kohl-lined eyes, a striped blue-and-gold royal headdress, golden collar on the chest
sphinx.neg: human body, two heads, statue, pyramid

pharao_der_knochen.desc: an undead pharaoh lich of human height, a skeletal body wrapped in loose yellowed mummy bandages, golden striped headdress, golden death mask partly broken over a skull, glowing turquoise eyes, ornate golden collar, a crook-shaped scepter in one hand, tattered royal linen kilt

riesenskorpion.desc: a giant scorpion as large as a wagon, eight jointed legs, heavy dark amber-brown armored carapace with black edges, two huge pincers, a long segmented tail arching over its back ending in a large curved stinger, a cluster of small black eyes, ridged plates on the abdomen

frostfuchs.desc: a white fox slightly larger than a normal fox, thick fluffy snow-white fur with icy pale blue tips, frost crystals clinging to the very bushy tail, small rounded ears, pale blue eyes, dark nose, small black-tipped paws, a thick ruff of fur around the neck, slim legs dusted with pale blue frost and a narrow pointed muzzle
frostfuchs.neg: orange fur, standing upright, two tails

reifkraehe.desc: a large crow about knee-high, glossy black feathers with white hoarfrost along the wing edges and tiny icicles hanging from the feathers, pale icy blue eyes, thick black beak frosted at the tip, black scaly legs, a ruff of frost-tipped neck feathers, a medium-length fanned tail and pale blue frost streaks across the back
reifkraehe.neg: four legs, human arms, two heads

tundramammut.desc: a woolly mammoth taller than two men, long shaggy reddish-brown fur hanging to the ground, high domed head with a sloping back, small ears, a long trunk, two enormous curved ivory tusks, thick pillar legs, short hairy tail, a dense darker woolly undercoat on the chest, broad round feet and small frost crystals in the long fur

eisspinne.desc: a large spider about the size of a dog, transparent icy body like clear glass with pale blue inner glow, eight long thin legs with frosted joints, a cluster of eight small glowing white eyes, crystalline fangs, frost crystals forming on the abdomen

schneeeule.desc: a large snow owl about waist-high to a human, round body covered in pure white feathers with faint gray speckles, round face disc, big yellow eyes, small black hooked beak, thickly feathered white feet with black talons, short broad wings with a few dark gray bars near the tips and a short rounded tail
schneeeule.neg: ear tufts, four legs, human arms, two heads

eisbaer.desc: a huge polar bear larger than a real one, thick creamy white fur, long neck and small head, black nose and dark eyes, massive paws with black claws, faint frost on the fur, scars across the muzzle, a long muscular body, thick neck, rounded small ears and dense fur around the large flat feet

frostelementar.desc: a humanoid ice elemental about twice the height of a man, body of jagged clear blue ice blocks and icicles, swirling snow and cold wind visible inside the chest, shard-like crown of ice spikes on the head, glowing pale cyan eyes, heavy arms ending in icicle claws, thick ice legs

aschschnee_wiesel.desc: a slender weasel about the length of a forearm, long lithe body, ash-gray fur with sooty dark speckles and white throat, short legs, small rounded ears, beady black eyes, sharp tiny teeth, long thin tail with a dark tip, a slightly paler gray belly and a faint darker mask around the eyes

yeti.desc: a huge yeti about twice the height of a man, covered in long shaggy white fur with icy blue tips, muscular ape-like body, very long arms with large clawed hands, broad flat face with pale blue leathery skin, small dark eyes, sharp fangs, large flat feet

eishexe.desc: an ice witch of human height, tall and thin, pale blue-white skin, long straight white hair with frost, cold glowing blue eyes, crown of icicles, a long flowing dark blue robe edged with white fur and frost patterns, a staff of twisted ice with a crystal on top

frostriese.desc: an ancient frost giant four times the height of a man, pale blue skin, long white braided beard with icicles, massive build, wears fur pelts, iron bracers and a horned helmet, holds a huge two-handed axe with a blade of blue ice

eiswurm.desc: a giant ice worm about five times the length of a man, thick segmented legless body with pale blue-white translucent skin and frosty ridges, a round mouth ringed with rows of icy teeth, no eyes, small crystal spikes along the back

schneegeist.desc: a snow spirit about human height, translucent body of swirling white snow and frost, a vague hooded female figure with a pale icy face and two glowing blue eyes, long trailing veil of snowflakes, no legs, ice crystals floating around
schneegeist.neg: solid flesh, legs on ground, warm colors
